claim: I chose the silence to protect you.

chapters.memory: Nia recalled entering the brine pump chamber during the first alarm of this emergency.

claim: A copied voice is not the person who owned it.
“A copied voice is not the person who owned it,” Kes said.
chapters.memory: Nia remembered a teacher whose name she had lost but whose patient pauses she still imitated.
chapters.knows: Nia knew the beacon’s other destination was a maintenance relay, not Earth.
chapters.misbelieves: Mira had believed the scratch was damage, but the manufacturer’s diagram showed it was a deliberate alignment mark.
chapters.suspect: Nia could only guess whether another habitat would answer before their orbit changed.
chapters.plan: She intended to testify at the inquiry after reaching the relay.
chapters.hypothesis: If Kes could refuse the old override, the copied voice might acquire a different history.
chapters.dream: She dreamed of a street on Earth where every window reflected Europa.
hooks: The silence resulted from a preserved override that disabled its own recorder.
The scratch aligned the wafer for an independent audit socket.
The commander’s voice came from Kes’s archived training material.
The second destination was the maintenance relay that could receive the audit.

relationship.anchor: Nia accepted Kes as a witness whose decisions still required independent review.

chapters.believes: Mira believed the relay crew would copy the audit before questioning them.
